ns2:section.sectionText: Section TIE: Theatre in Europe. A four-week theatre course on select European theatre topics held on site in Athens, Avignon, Paris, and London. Please contact Dr. Peter Davis at 217-333-8619 for more information. Students do not need to complete an independent study proposal form fo this class. In addition to attending classes and 12-15 performances, students will be required to write four 1000 word essays based on the class presentations and performances viewed. June 30 - July 31, 2005.
